verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's formation and document pages describe guided intake flows (LLC/Inc/Nonprofit selection, EIN, operating agreement) and bundle attorney consultations as an add-on, implying some guided document creation with attorney access, but no evidence describes an actual in-flow mechanism that flags specific questionnaire choices for attorney review. Community comments (e.g., on operating agreements needing real legal judgment) hint at this gap rather than confirming a flagging feature. Missing for 10: explicit product description of adaptive questionnaire logic, examples of flagged decision points, and independent confirmation that documents are validated/flagged during intake rather than just offering separate attorney consults.
